t: Casing blocks are the building blocks of the Energizer.$(br2)They are required to build its frame and faces, and are also used to craft the other parts.
机壳方块是构成充能器的基础方块。$(br2)它们既是建造其框架和各个面的必需部分，也用于合成其他部件。
$(l)Mandatory:$() they are required to build the frame and the faces$(br)$(l)Valid positions:$() any$(br)$(l)Graphical interface:$() no
